faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for UoH Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 3 December 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in UoH Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 4 vacancies: 1 Guest Faculty (MBA General), 1 Guest Faculty (MBA Healthcare and Hospital Management), 2 Guest Faculty (MBA Business Analytics).

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for UoH Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form and send it to The Dean, School of Management Studies, University of Hyderabad, Dr. C.R. Rao Road, Central University Post, Hyderabad-500046, by hard copy to the dean; soft copy by email, to reach by 3 December 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: Honorarium of Rs. 1500 per hour subject to maximum of Rs. 50,000 P.M. in case of two courses for Guest Faculty (MBA General), Honorarium of Rs. 1500 per hour subject to maximum of Rs. 50,000 P.M. in case of two courses for Guest Faculty (MBA Healthcare and Hospital Management), Honorarium of Rs. 1500 per hour subject to maximum of Rs. 50,000 P.M. in case of two courses for Guest Faculty (MBA Business Analytics).

faq.question: Q5. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Bachelor's degree in any discipline and Master's Degree in Business Administration/PGDM/CA/CS/ICWA/M.Com with first class or equivalent, and 2 years professional experience after the Master's degree (experience exempted for Ph.D./FPM holders). Industry professionals in Health Care, Data Science and Business Analytics also considered as per AICTE/UGC norms. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q6. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Must participate in seminars and other academic activities and guide students as assigned by the Dean. Must undertake teaching and student mentoring and not leave in the middle of the semester. Responsible for continuous and term-end evaluation of students.

faq.question: Q7. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Interview (may be conducted in online mode). Interviews may be conducted in online mode on 7 December 2026. Interview link will be sent one day before.

faq.question: Q8. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Engagement for I & II regular semesters January-June 2027.

faq.answer: School of Management Studies, University of Hyderabad, Hyderabad.
